# Generated egress table

<!-- egress-table:begin (generated by scripts/measure_rm07_egress.py) -->
These rows are the design's allowed list. No capture has been taken yet: the unit has not arrived, and a capture replaces this line when it has.

| What | Where it goes | When it happens | Leaves your home |
|---|---|---|---|
| Your MaiPai Home | The hub's address on your own network | During a conversation and while the robot is on | No |
| Looking up an address by name (DNS) | Your router or local name server | Whenever the robot needs an address | No |
| Finding your hub on your own network (mDNS) | Multicast on your local network | While the robot is on | No |
| Asking your router for an address (DHCP) | Your router | When the robot joins your network | No |

Two controls here are software, not hardware. **Mute** is a software switch: the robot's microphone stays powered and the Eyes show amber. Watch level `off` is a software setting, not a shutter: the lens is not covered, and the Eyes show a dark segment.
<!-- egress-table:end -->
